The gate matrix holds across 13 hermetic rows, and the naive sed extraction is unspoofable by any JSON-valid payload. The sentinel proof stands on its negative control — broken hook returns NONE, fixed hook returns the exact 16-hex token — with guessing, inference, repo leakage and operator-channel routes each closed, including confirming the token appears nowhere in the committed tree. Surface is net +378 across 7 paths for a ~24-line shipped mechanism; the test file is 75% of it.
